findings.message: The source quantifies over every integer k ≠ 1 and explicitly discusses k = -1. The Lean declaration instead elaborates k as Nat and assumes k > 1, so it omits k = 0 and every negative integer. This materially weakens the cited problem.
findings.suggestion: Use an integer parameter and integer congruence, for example: `answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ 1 → { n : ℕ | (2 : ℤ) ^ n ≡ k [ZMOD n] }.Infinite`. This replacement type-checks.
